system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: At each step, the system combines global memory with the current task specification to form an execution context.
system_prompt_style.note: Always-on L1 memory index plus continuously injected working-memory anchor; code not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: file_read supports segmented reads (start/count), keyword anchoring, and line-number output, so GA can inspect only the relevant regions.
env_context_strategy.note: Memory index injected, but environment knowledge obtained via tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Tool outputs are first truncated with a head-tail policy to bound the size of individual messages. Redundant content in older messages is then compressed at the tag level to remove low-value fragments. When the global context budget is exceeded, the oldest messages are evicted in chronological order.
context_compaction.note: Tag-level compression coded as summarize (heuristic); source code not in evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Its browser interaction layer represents web pages through semantically structured observations rather than raw HTML
observation_format.note: web_scan serialised simplified DOM coded as a11y_tree (closest value).

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: `claude`（不含 `native`） | ClaudeSession | 文本协议工具 | **deprecated**
tool_call_format.note: Native sessions (API tool fields) recommended default; deprecated text-protocol sessions also shipped; text syntax unknown, coded xml_tags as closest.

tool_count.evidence_quote: GA exposes nine atomic tools, organized into five capability classes.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: file_patch enforces unique old_content matching and fails fast on zero or multiple matches

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Each tool defines a name, a description, and a set of parameters described by JSON Schema, all under a consistent type function format.

protocol_standardization.note: No source tree or dependency file in evidence to grep for MCP.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The LLM processes this context and produces either direct outputs or tool calls. Tool execution is delegated to external modules, and the results are returned as structured signals that update the system state.
loop_primitives.note: Reflect mode triggers on environment events (watchdog); goal mode also shipped.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Working memoryis continuously injected across turns, carrying only the minimal necessary task state: current objectives, constraints, and progress.
planning_granularity.note: A Plan mode is mentioned in docs but its structure is not in evidence.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Conductor sub-agent orchestration**. Spawn, supervise, and auto-clean parallel sub-agents
multi_agent_topology.note: Default single agent; Conductor/Goal Hive orchestrator-workers are opt-in modes.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Conductor sub-agent orchestration**. Spawn, supervise, and auto-clean parallel sub-agents

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The Human-in-the-loopclass is ask_user, used when user decisions are required.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: | **L4** | Session Archive | Archived task records distilled from finished sessions for long-horizon recall |
long_term_memory.note: L2 facts/L3 SOPs in memory/ files.

state_persistence.note: /continue picker mentioned; code not in evidence.

retry_policy.note: Mixin max_retries is API failover, not task retry.

termination_condition.note: Paper mentions explicit execution bounds without detail; loop code truncated.

timeouts.note: Goal mode time budget mentioned; tool code absent.
